policy: Official Microsoft skills from azure@azure-skills are the default. Where no official skill covers a capability Threadlight needs, the awesome-gbb skill is ported into threadlight-skills as a threadlight-owned skill or reference (MIT, with PROVENANCE.md), so Threadlight runs on azure@azure-skills plus threadlight-skills only. Other awesome-gbb skills are labelled residual: optional, not Threadlight dependencies; each exception records its evidence. Out-of-product-scope tools are not Azure product dependencies.

microsoft-foundry.note: Deploy stops the presenter handoff (docs/presenter-ready.md). Hosted-agent layout, azd modules, Foundry App Insights wiring and evals continue from the Threadlight-owned references; prompt agents, toolbox, routines, RBAC and private networking have no Threadlight fallback.

azure-prepare.note: threadlight-deploy still generates the azd project from its own module catalog; run azd provision/deploy as its SKILL.md describes.

azure-validate.note: Use threadlight-deploy's offline generation checks and threadlight-safe-check; there is no official pre-deploy validation pass.

azure-deploy.note: Run azd up as threadlight-deploy's SKILL.md describes; there is no official deploy diagnosis.

azure-diagnostics.note: No Threadlight equivalent: Threadlight stages that need it stop at that step and report it; the rest of the pilot continues.

azure-ai.note: No Threadlight equivalent: Threadlight stages that need it stop at that step and report it; the rest of the pilot continues.

appinsights-instrumentation.note: Foundry account-level App Insights wiring continues from the Threadlight-owned observability reference; generic app instrumentation has no fallback.

azure-aigateway.note: Use the Threadlight-owned Citadel hub for APIM AI-gateway patterns.

azure-compliance.note: threadlight-production-ready still reports its own findings; there is no official compliance scan.

entra-app-registration.note: No Threadlight equivalent: Threadlight stages that need it stop at that step and report it; the rest of the pilot continues.

cost-analysis.note: Token-span chargeback continues in threadlight-consumption-iq; bill analysis has no fallback.

cost-estimation.note: No Threadlight equivalent: Threadlight stages that need it stop at that step and report it; the rest of the pilot continues.

cost-governance.note: No Threadlight equivalent: Threadlight stages that need it stop at that step and report it; the rest of the pilot continues.

foundry-iq.note: Knowledge-source ACL and citation evidence continues in threadlight-ground; Foundry IQ setup has no fallback.

frozen_consumers: Live demos and library processes keep their recorded awesome-gbb pins; this manifest does not change them.
